title: WorkflowFrontmatterSchema
description: Google Antigravity Workflow YAML frontmatter schema (.agents/workflows/<name>.md, .agent/workflows/<name>.md, ~/.gemini/antigravity/global_workflows/). Workflow bodies are ordered Markdown step lists invoked via /workflow-name.

name.description: Unique workflow identifier; defaults to the file name when omitted.

description.description: Short description of the workflow shown to the model when deciding whether to run it.
